info.title: StampMitra Developer API
info.summary: Indian identity verification and e-Stamp Paper APIs for the StampMitra developer portal.
info.description: The API-key Developer Suite: verification (PAN, GSTIN, vehicle RC, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, CIN, Udyam, bank account), e-Stamp Paper, usage and request logs, and webhook events. Generated from the same data as the docs at https://developer.stampmitra.in. Sandbox keys (sk_test_) are free; production calls are metered per successful call.

servers.description: StampMitra Developer API (sandbox keys use the same host with sk_test_ keys)

post.description: Validates and verifies a PAN. Requires the `verification.pan.read` scope on the API key. Metered as `pan.verify` after a successful response - usage is only recorded (and the fulfilment wallet debited, for priced services) once verification completes successfully. The response below is the exact real shape returned by `/v1/verify/pan`, including its `referenceId` field.

get.summary: List entitled services (generic catalog, covers e-Stamp services too)
get.description: Returns every service (verification AND e-Stamp) this organization is entitled to. There is no e-Stamp-specific catalog endpoint yet; e-Stamp instruments surface here as regular service entries once entitled.
Detail for a single serviceCode, if entitled and active.

get.summary: Get the e-Stamp input field schema
get.description: Generic form-rendering metadata for the e-Stamp product. `serviceCode` is accepted for forward-compatible route shape parity with other schema lookups; e-Stamp has exactly one schema regardless of its value. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.
Served from StampMitra's synced master-data catalogue. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.
There is no separate instrument entity distinct from an article - this returns the same state-scoped article catalogue as the articles endpoint below. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.
`instrumentCode` is treated as a state code here - there is no article sub-breakdown below the state-scoped list. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.

post.summary: Calculate authoritative e-Stamp duty + service charges
post.description: Runs the one authoritative pricing calculation; the response amount is never recalculated or overridden client-side. Requires the `estamp.duty.calculate` scope. Metered against your fulfilment wallet.
Attaches or corrects the customer/party details on an existing e-Stamp order. Requires the `estamp.parties.write` scope. Metered against your fulfilment wallet.

post.summary: Create an order (generic - works for any entitled serviceCode, including e-Stamp)
post.description: Generic order-creation endpoint. For e-Stamp, pass an e-Stamp `serviceCode` (from GET /v1/services) and put instrument/party/value details in the free-form `details` object. There is no e-Stamp-specific request/response contract yet (no first-class `state`, `article`, `parties[]` fields) - the shape of `details` for e-Stamp is not finalized upstream.

externalOrderId.description: Your own reference for this order.

externalCustomerId.description: Your own reference for the customer.

serviceCode.description: The entitled service to order (e.g. an estamp.* code).

details.description: Free-form service-specific payload (e-Stamp field shape is not finalized).
